name: scidraw-ai
description: Create, edit and convert publication-ready scientific figures and charts with SciDraw AI.

interface.shortDescription: Scientific illustrations, charts and editable figure exports.
interface.longDescription: Turn a research description, sketch or dataset into a publication-ready figure, refine it in conversation, and export editable SVG or PowerPoint files. Uses your SciDraw AI account and credits.
defaultPrompt: Connect to SciDraw AI, check that its tools are available, and introduce what it can do for my research figures.
